rows.en: We are. Big sister is cooking.
I am busy. You go ahead and eat.

rows.zh: 她说她忙. 别忘了她的饺子!
rows.en: She says she is busy. Do not forget her dumplings!

你: A person: the one you are talking to.
们: It turns one person into several: 你们 is all of you.
做: Making and doing are what people do.

traps.谁: The middle of 谁 looks like 亻, but it belongs to the right-hand part. 谁 carries 讠 SPEECH.

好: A woman with a child 子: the old picture of something good.
奶: 奶奶 is grandma, your father's mother.
她: 他 with the person swapped for a woman.

谁: A question you ask. You will hear both shéi and shuí.

想: Wanting happens in the heart. Underneath, the radical keeps its full shape 心.
忙: A state of mind. On the left the heart thins to 忄.
快: It first meant glad, as it still does in 快乐, happy.
忘: Lost 亡 from the heart 心.

radNotes.person: 亻 is for people in general. Another radical is narrower: women and family.

builds.posNote: 女 stands on the left and narrows a little to make room.
builds.done: 女 says a woman. 马 mǎ lends its sound: mā.

radNotes.mouth: 口 is for eating and noises. A polite request is made in words.

builds.posNote: 讠 is the thin side form of 言. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 讠 says it is spoken. 青 qīng lends its sound: qǐng.

builds.posNote: Underneath, the heart keeps its full shape 心. On the left it thins to 忄.
builds.done: 心 says it happens in the heart. 相 xiāng lends its sound: xiǎng.

rows.en: It is nothing serious. Get more sleep.
Drink more water and look at your phone less.
Rub ointment on the foot and change the dressing every day.
Come back tomorrow for an injection.

痒: Not quite pain, but still a complaint.
病: The radical is named after this one.

hunts.hint: It usually stands on the left. Look underneath as well.

胃: An organ of the body. Here 月 sits underneath.
背: A part of the body, again with 月 underneath.
脚: The foot as a part of the body. ⻊ FOOT is kept for what feet do.

traps.睛: There is a small 月 in 睛, at the bottom of its sound part 青. The meaning part is 目 EYE.
traps.明: The 月 in 明 is the moon, beside the sun 日: bright. Same shape, but not the body.

眼: The everyday word is 眼睛, and both halves carry 目.
睛: The second half of 眼睛, eye.
看: A hand 手 shading the eye. Here 目 sits underneath.

按: Pressing is done with the hand. 按时 is keeping to the time.
抹: You rub it on with your hand.
换: Swapping one thing for another, by hand.
打: A hand strikes. 打针 is to give an injection.

traps.看: The top of 看 is a whole hand 手, shading the eye. But 看 is about seeing, so it carries 目 EYE.

builds.posNote: 扌 is the thin side form of 手. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 扌 says a hand does it. 丁 dīng lends the start of its sound: dǎ.

radNotes.walk: 辶 is about distance and travel. This one is what the feet themselves do.
radNotes.flesh: 月 names parts of the body. Running is something the feet do.

builds.posNote: ⻊ is 足 squeezed onto the left, with its last stroke tilted up.
builds.done: ⻊ says the feet do it. 包 bāo lends its sound: pǎo.

radNotes.flesh: 月 names parts of the body. Being unwell has a radical of its own.

builds.posNote: 疒 covers the top and runs down the left side.
builds.done: 疒 says illness. 丙 bǐng lends its sound: bìng.

rows.en: A big gap between morning and evening temperatures.
Take an umbrella when you go out.

霜: Cold weather settling on the ground.

hunts.hint: Look on the left first, then underneath.

春: The season the sun comes back. Here 日 sits underneath.
明: Sun and moon 月 together. 明天 is tomorrow.

traps.温: There is a 日 in 温, but it sits inside the right-hand part. The meaning part is 氵 WATER.
traps.湿: There is a 日 in 湿, but it sits inside the right-hand part. The meaning part is 氵 WATER.

汉: 汉 began as the name of a river. 武汉 stands where it meets the Yangtze.
温: Warm was first said of water.
滑: A wet road is a slippery one.

traps.冷: 冷 has two drops, not three. 冫 is ICE, a different radical.

radNotes.rain: 雨 is for weather from the sky. Washing uses water on the ground.

builds.posNote: 氵 is the thin side form of 水. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 氵 says water is involved. 先 xiān lends the start of its sound: xǐ.

radNotes.water: A fair guess, since boiling needs water. This character points at what does the heating.

builds.posNote: Underneath, 火 flattens into four dots, 灬: a fire under the pot.
builds.done: 灬 says fire. 者 zhě lends the start of its sound: zhǔ.

radNotes.water: 氵 is for water you can pour. Fog hangs in the sky.

builds.posNote: 雨 always sits on top, pressed flat, like the sky it falls from.
builds.done: 雨 says weather. 务 wù lends its whole sound: wù.

猫: 熊猫, bear cat, is the giant panda.
狐: 狐狸 is a fox, and both halves carry 犭.
狸: The second half of 狐狸, fox.

hunts.hint: It usually stands on the left. Look underneath as well.

蛇: 虫 began as a drawing of a snake.
蝴: 蝴蝶 is a butterfly, and both halves carry 虫.
蝶: The second half of 蝴蝶.
蛙: Small, damp and hopping: frogs are filed with the bugs.
蜜: Made by insects. Here 虫 sits underneath.

荷: A water plant. 荷花 is its flower.
草: The radical is named after it.

traps.猫: There is a 艹 in 猫, on top of its sound part 苗 miáo. The meaning part is 犭 ANIMAL.

树: The everyday word for a tree.
梅: A fruit tree, loved for its winter blossom.

traps.茶: The bottom of 茶 looks like 木, but tea is a leafy plant: it carries 艹 GRASS.
traps.蝶: There is a 木 in 蝶, at the bottom of its sound part. The meaning part is 虫 BUG.

radNotes.tree: 木 is for trees and things made of wood. Flowers and leafy plants take another one.

builds.posNote: 艹 always sits on top.
builds.done: 艹 says it is a plant. 化 huà lends its sound: huā.

radNotes.bug: 虫 is for insects and small crawling things. A cat has four legs and fur.

builds.posNote: 犭 is the side form of 犬, dog. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 犭 says an animal. 苗 miáo lends its sound: māo, close to a meow.

radNotes.animal: 犭 is for four-legged animals. This one has six legs and wings.

builds.posNote: 虫 stands on the left here. In a few characters, such as 蜜, it drops to the bottom.
builds.done: 虫 says a bug. 文 wén lends its whole sound: wén.

海: Seafood comes out of the sea.
河: 河粉 is short for Shahe noodles, named after a town whose name means sand river.
沙: Sand lies where water has been. Here 沙拉 only spells out the sound of salad: shālā.
汽: Steam rises off water. 汽水 is gas water.

traps.冰: 冰 has two drops, not three. 冫 is ICE, a different radical.

炒: Tossed in a pan over a flame.
烧: 红烧 is red-braising: cooked slowly over heat.
煎: The fire sits underneath, flattened into 灬.
热: Heat, with the fire underneath as 灬.

饭: The everyday word for a meal.
馒: 馒头 is a plain steamed bun.

radNotes.mouth: 口 marks eating as something you do, as in 吃. The meal itself takes another one.

builds.posNote: 饣 is the thin side form of 食. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 饣 says food. 反 fǎn lends its sound: fàn.

radNotes.roof: 宀 covers a house from above. This one is what you walk through.

builds.posNote: 门 stands around the outside, and the other part goes in the doorway.
builds.done: Sunlight 日 through the gap in a door: the space between. Both parts carry meaning here, and neither gives the sound.

radNotes.person: A fair guess, since a guest is a person. This character is about being under someone's roof.

builds.posNote: 宀 always sits on top, like the roof it is.
builds.done: 宀 says under a roof. 各 gè lends its ending: kè.

通: A way through is a way you can walk.
道: A road is for walking. 通道 is a passage.
退: Stepping backwards. 退票 hands a ticket back.
运: Moving things from place to place.

轮: What a vehicle rolls on. 轮椅 is a wheelchair.
辆: 一辆车 is one car. 车辆 is vehicles in general.
转: Wheels go round. 转车 is changing trains.
软: First said of a cart with padded wheels, for a gentle ride.

铁: A metal. 地铁, ground iron, is the underground railway.
银: A metal. 银行, silver house, is a bank.
镜: The first mirrors were polished bronze. 眼镜 is glasses.

hunts.hint: Look on the left and underneath.

贵: It costs many shells. 贵宾 is an honoured guest.
费: Shells going out. 免费 is free of charge.

radNotes.foot: ⻊ is for what feet do: run, jump, kick. Distance and travel take another one.

builds.posNote: 辶 always wraps the left side and the bottom.
builds.done: 辶 says it is about movement and distance. 元 yuán lends its sound: yuǎn.

radNotes.sun: 日 marks time, as in 时. This is the thing itself, and it was first cast in bronze.

builds.posNote: 钅 is the thin side form of 金. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 钅 says metal. 中 zhōng lends its whole sound: zhōng.

radNotes.metal: 钅 gives 钱, money as coins. Trade goes back further, to shells.

builds.posNote: 贝 often sits underneath, as in 贵 and 费. It can also stand on the left, as in 购.
builds.done: 贝 says trade. 化 huà lends its sound: huò, as it did in 花 huā.

hunts.hint: It can stand on the left or sit on top.

峰: The very top of a mountain.
崖: A mountain with a sheer drop. Here 山 sits on top.
岩: Mountain 山 over stone 石: the rock a mountain is made of.
岸: Where the land rises out of the water.

碎: 碎石 is crushed stone: gravel.
矿: Where rock is dug out for what is in it.
碑: A standing stone with words cut into it.

traps.岩: There is a whole 石 in 岩, underneath. But dictionaries file 岩 under the part on top, 山 MOUNTAIN.

hunts.hint: The ear has to be on the left.

险: A steep slope is a risky place.
陡: What a hillside is when it is hard to climb.
阳: At first: the sunny side of the hill.
院: Ground closed in by walls of earth.

traps.邮: Look at which side the ear is on. In 邮 it stands on the right, and that makes it ⻏ TOWN: post goes from town to town.

hunts.hint: Count the dots: two, not three.

冰: Ice 冫 beside water 水.
冷: The everyday word for cold. 冷面 is a dish of cold noodles.
凉: Pleasantly cold. 凉茶 is a herbal tea drunk to cool down.

traps.滑: 滑 has three drops, so it is 氵 WATER: slippery when wet.
traps.河: 河 has three drops, so it is 氵 WATER. Ice has only two.

radNotes.earth: 土 is soil and ground in general. The lines between one plot and the next belong to the farmland.

builds.posNote: 田 sits on top here, as it does in 男 and 思.
builds.done: 田 says fields, and the edges between them. 介 jiè lends its whole sound: jiè.

radNotes.water: 氵 has three drops and stays liquid. Cold takes one drop away.
radNotes.rain: 雨 is for weather that falls from the sky. Cold itself has a smaller sign.

builds.posNote: 冫 always stands on the left: two dots where water has three.
builds.done: 冫 says cold. 令 lìng lends a rough sound: lěng.

radNotes.town: The shape is the same, but TOWN names places on the map. A wall of earth to shelter behind is HILL.
radNotes.earth: 土 is soil and ground in general. A bank or wall built up from it takes another radical.

builds.posNote: On the left the ear is ⻖ HILL. The same ear on the right would be ⻏ TOWN.
builds.done: ⻖ says a bank of earth, here one built to keep trouble out. 方 fāng lends its sound: fáng.

hunts.hint: The ear has to be on the right.

邮: Letters travel from town to town.
部: At first the name of a district. 东部 is the eastern part.
邻: The people in your part of town.

traps.院: Look at which side the ear is on. In 院 it stands on the left, and that makes it ⻖ HILL: a yard inside earth walls.

hunts.hint: A dot on top, then a roof with one wall.

店: A roofed place to sell from.
府: A large official building. 政府 is the government.
库: A shelter for carts 车. 车库 is a garage.

traps.厅: No dot on top of 厅. Without the dot it is 厂 CLIFF.
traps.厦: No dot on top of 厦. Without the dot it is 厂 CLIFF.
traps.厕: No dot on top of 厕. Without the dot it is 厂 CLIFF.
traps.厂: 厂 has no dot on top. It is CLIFF, standing alone as the word for a factory.

hunts.hint: No dot on top.

厅: A big sheltered room. 餐厅 is a dining hall.
厦: 大厦 is a tower block.

traps.店: 店 has a dot on top. With the dot it is 广 SHELTER.
traps.庙: 庙 has a dot on top. With the dot it is 广 SHELTER.
traps.府: 府 has a dot on top. With the dot it is 广 SHELTER.
traps.库: 库 has a dot on top. With the dot it is 广 SHELTER.
traps.广: 广 has a dot on top. It is SHELTER, standing alone as the word for wide.

hunts.hint: The box has to hold the rest of the character inside it.

国: Jade 玉 kept safe inside its borders.
回: One box inside another: going round and coming back.

traps.口: 口 by itself is the small box, MOUTH: here an opening, the way in. ENCLOSURE is the big frame with something inside it.

radNotes.roof: 宀 is for what goes on indoors. An empty hollow has the same top with two legs added.

builds.posNote: 穴 always sits on top, like the roof it grew from.
builds.done: 穴 says a hollow with nothing in it. 工 gōng lends its sound: kōng.

radNotes.cliff: Close. 厂 has no dot on top. Buildings put up for a purpose take the one with the dot.
radNotes.roof: 宀 covers both sides and is for home life. A shop is open at the front.

builds.posNote: 广 covers the top and runs down the left side.
builds.done: 广 says a building. 占 zhàn lends a rough sound: diàn.

radNotes.mouth: 口 is the small box, for mouths and sounds. Land with a fence around it needs the big one.
radNotes.door: 门 is open at the bottom. A garden is closed in on every side.

builds.posNote: 囗 goes all the way around and the other part sits inside.
builds.done: 囗 says closed in on every side. 元 yuán lends its whole sound: yuán.

骆: First half of 骆驼, camel: a beast you ride, like a horse.
驼: Second half of 骆驼. Both halves carry 马.
骑: What you do on a horse.

hunts.hint: It usually stands on the right. Look underneath as well.

鹅: A bigger bird of the pond.
鹰: A bird of prey. Here 鸟 sits underneath.

traps.岛: There is a bird in 岛, with its legs tucked away: a bird resting on a mountain in the sea. Dictionaries file it under 山 MOUNTAIN.

鲸: Not a fish, but it lives like one.
鳄: Not a fish either. For the people who made the character, it lived in the water.
鲤: The fish of ponds and New Year pictures.
鲜: Fish 鱼 and sheep 羊: both best eaten fresh.

hunts.hint: On the left the cow leans over and loses a stroke end: 牜.

牧: Driving cattle with a stick in the hand 攵. 牧场 is a farm for grazing.
物: At first a kind of cow. Now it is any thing at all, and 动物 is a moving thing: an animal.
特: At first a bull, the one that stands out in the herd.

radNotes.woman: 女 gives 好, good. Beauty was first measured in sheep.

builds.posNote: On top, 羊 loses the end of its tail to make room for the part below.
builds.done: A sheep 羊 over big 大: to a herder, a big fat sheep was a beautiful sight. Two meanings joined, with no sound part.

radNotes.animal: 犭 is for beasts on four legs. Anything with feathers has its own radical.

builds.posNote: 鸟 usually stands on the right, as in 鸭 and 鹅.
builds.done: 鸟 says a bird. 又 is only shorthand here, standing in for a longer part that once gave the sound.

radNotes.water: 氵 is for liquids. Fresh was first said of what is caught in the water.
radNotes.food: 饣 is for meals and eating. Start from the animal, before it is cooked.

builds.posNote: 鱼 stands on the left and flattens its tail into one stroke.
builds.done: Fish 鱼 and sheep 羊, both best eaten fresh. Two meanings joined, with no sound part.

糖: The first sweets were boiled down from grain.
粥: Rice boiled soft. Here 米 sits in the middle.

hunts.hint: Look for the line inside the jar.

酒: Liquid 氵 from the jar. Dictionaries file it under the jar.
酱: Fermented in a jar. Here 酉 sits underneath.
酸: The taste of something fermented. 酸奶 is sour milk: yoghurt.

traps.西: 西 is empty inside. 酉 has one more line across the middle: the wine in the jar. 西 means west, and 西瓜 is the melon from the west.

hunts.hint: It always sits at the bottom.

盖: What goes on top of the dish.

hunts.hint: On the left, underneath, or in the middle of the bottom.

带: A belt with its tied ends hanging down.

radNotes.tree: Close. 木 has a flat top. The season is named for the crop, with its drooping head.
radNotes.sun: 日 marks time in 时 and 早. The farm year goes by the crop.

builds.posNote: 禾 stands on the left and pulls in its last stroke.
builds.done: Grain 禾 the colour of fire 火: harvest time. Two meanings joined, with no sound part.

radNotes.food: 饣 is for meals and eating. Sugar was first boiled down from grain, so it takes the grain itself.
radNotes.grain: 禾 is the crop standing in the field. What is made from the harvest takes another radical.

builds.posNote: 米 stands on the left and pulls in its last stroke.
builds.done: 米 says it is made from grain. 唐 táng lends its whole sound: táng.

radNotes.mouth: There is a 口 in this one, inside the sound part. The meaning is the container underneath.

builds.posNote: 皿 always sits at the bottom and holds up the rest like a tray.
builds.done: 皿 says a container. 合 hé lends its whole sound, and its meaning too: a box is a dish that closes.

rows.en: Up you get! We are going for a run.
I can't. I am so tired.
Come on! Put your back into it!
Turn left and take the path.
I have caught up with you!
Do not give up. Get moving!
You are getting faster and faster.
That is it for today! Tomorrow the time changes.
Thank you for helping me, Coach.

hunts.hint: Two slanted strokes on top, not one.

很: One of the commonest characters of all. The road in it faded long ago.
得: At first: to go out and come back with something. 得了第一 is to take first place.

traps.行: 行 is the whole crossroads that 彳 was cut from. It has a radical entry of its own.
traps.你: Count the strokes on top. 你 has one, so it is 亻 PERSON. 彳 has two.
traps.他: Count the strokes on top. 他 has one, so it is 亻 PERSON. 彳 has two.
traps.们: Count the strokes on top. 们 has one, so it is 亻 PERSON. 彳 has two.

hunts.hint: Its last stroke stretches out under the other part.

赶: 赶上 is to catch up.
超: Running past the others. 超过 is to pass.
越: to cross over, more and more
Getting past a line. 越来越快 is faster and faster.

hunts.hint: On the right, underneath, and once on the left.

加: Strength 力 added to words 口. 加油, add oil, is how you cheer someone on.
努: 努力 is to try hard. Here 力 sits underneath.
动: It takes force to move something.

traps.别: There is a 力 in 别, tucked into the bottom of its left half. The radical is the knife on the right, 刂: to part, to cut away.

放: 放弃 is to let go and give up.
收: 收队 is calling the team in.
教: A child 子 and a teacher's stick. 教练 is a coach.

radNotes.hand: 扌 would do for pulling in general. This word began with one thing that is drawn open.
radNotes.strength: 力 is for effort and force. This word began with the thing the force is used on.

builds.posNote: 弓 stands on the left, tall and narrow.
builds.done: 弓 says a bow, drawn wide open. 长 zhǎng lends its sound: zhāng.

radNotes.hand: 扌 is for what the hand does directly. 攵 is a hand with a stick: doing something to something.

builds.posNote: 攵 nearly always stands on the right.
builds.done: 攵 says something is done to something: here, sending it off. 方 fāng lends its sound: fàng.

radNotes.foot: ⻊ is for what feet do on the spot: jump, kick, step on. Getting up and going takes another.
radNotes.walk: 辶 is one smooth line, for distance and travel. This one keeps the whole of 走.

builds.posNote: 走 stands on the left and stretches its last stroke out under the other part.
builds.done: 走 says getting on your feet. 己 jǐ lends its sound: qǐ.

rows.zh: 孩子免费, 学生半价.

rows.en: Collect your headphones at the front desk.

rows.zh: 禁止拍照, 请勿大声聊天.
rows.en: No photos. Please do not chat loudly.

hunts.hint: It looks like 王, a king, standing on the left.

珠: A small round gem. 珍珠 is a pearl.
环: At first a ring of jade.
玻: First half of 玻璃, glass: once as rare as a gem.
璃: Second half of 玻璃. Both halves carry the jade.
球: At first a round jade bead.

hunts.hint: One dot on the right side, not two. Look underneath as well.

福: A blessing. This is the character pasted on doors at New Year.
礼: At first a ceremony at the altar. 礼品 is a gift.
禁: At first what the spirits did not allow. Here the full 示 sits underneath.

项: 项链 is a neck chain.
预: The head goes first. 预约 is to book ahead.
领: The neck holds the head up. 领取 is to collect something.
顺: Heads all facing the same way, like water in a stream 川.

traps.费: The bottom of 费 is 贝 SHELL: money. 页 has two more strokes on top.

职: At first: to listen and remember. 职员 is a member of staff.
联: At first an ear tied on with thread. 联系 is to get in touch.

traps.取: There is a whole ear in 取: at first, a hand 又 taking an ear. But dictionaries file it under the hand, 又.

radNotes.person: 亻 is for people in general. The young have a radical of their own.
radNotes.woman: 女 is for women and the family. The young have a radical of their own.

builds.posNote: 子 stands on the left and tilts its long stroke upward.
builds.done: 子 says a child. 亥 hài lends its sound: hái.

radNotes.flesh: 月 names the parts of the body lower down. The head and neck have a radical of their own.
radNotes.shell: Close. 贝 is money. 页 has two more strokes on top, and it is a head.

builds.posNote: 页 always stands on the right.
builds.done: 页 says the head and neck. 令 lìng lends its sound: lǐng.

radNotes.stone: 石 is for rock and hard things. Gems are filed with the most precious stone of all.
radNotes.metal: 钅 is for metals. Pearls and gems go with jade.
radNotes.shell: A pearl does come out of a shell, but 贝 is for money and trade.

builds.posNote: 王 stands on the left, with its bottom stroke tilted up.
builds.done: 王 says a gem. 朱 zhū lends its whole sound: zhū.
